meal.title: Import BeautifulSoup and requests, then load local HTML
meal.objective: Import BeautifulSoup and requests, then read an HTML file into a string

voice.script:
How do you bring a webpage into Python? How to import libraries and load HTML from a file? We import BeautifulSoup and requests, then read the file into a string. Here is the minimal code you need:

from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests

with open('simple.html') as f:
    html = f.read()

Running it prints nothing, but now html contains the page source. You can picture the file being read into memory as a simple text block. Importing modules and reading files are the first steps before parsing. Create a file named sample.html with any HTML and run the script.
